meta.framing: The screens below are captured from the live product. One seeded student — the 73% receipt — is illustrative, labeled wherever it appears. No outcome stats, no pricing: capability facts only.

hero.headline: Snap the homework. The grading and the understanding check run themselves — and you get your evenings back.
hero.subhead: The nights spent grading at the kitchen table. Never quite sure who actually understands until the test tells you. Veradic reads each student's handwritten work, grades every problem with a receipt, has a calm three-minute chat to check they truly get it, then hands you a class you can see at a glance — and the few who need you.

loop.title: One loop, from a photo to a class you can see
loop.sub: The pieces fit into a single rhythm. A student sends their work; you get back a graded, understood, triaged class — without the kitchen-table night.

beats.title: The AI grades it — with a receipt
beats.line: Every problem scored, every point traced back to the handwriting it came from.

beats.title: It checks they understand
beats.line: A short, calm conversation that catches the memorizer one graded answer can't.

beats.title: You see the class at a glance
beats.line: A graded roster with the few who need a human surfaced — not the whole stack to re-check.

useCases.title: Four pieces that change the week — open any one
useCases.sub: Each is a real, working surface. Step into it to see the actual product, end to end, with the system's own output.

cards.title: The understanding check
cards.benefit: Catches the smooth memorizer that one graded answer can't. A calm three-minute chat per student — and the kid never sees a verdict, so a teacher always makes the call.

cards.title: AI grading you can defend
cards.benefit: Every problem scored with a receipt — 100 − 20 − 7 = 73% — sitting right next to the handwriting it came from. You review the few it's unsure about and sign off.

cards.title: Problem generation
cards.benefit: Turn a worksheet into a ready-to-assign set — every problem independently re-derived, figures and worked solutions included, so the answer key is never quietly wrong.

cards.title: Your teaching week
cards.benefit: Walk in to a to-do list, not a scoreboard — the few students who need you surfaced first, then turn a class-wide gap into ten practice problems in one click.

roi.title: What it's worth to you
roi.sub: Veradic grades every paper and runs the understanding check; you review the slice that's flagged or uncertain. Drag your own class through the model below — the arithmetic is right there, nothing hidden.

payoff.title: What the whole platform gives back.
payoff.lead: Not another dashboard to babysit. Three things that actually change your week:

points.title: Your evenings
points.body: The grading and the understanding check run on their own. You review the handful that need a human — not the whole stack at 10pm.

points.title: Fair and accurate
points.body: Every grade itemized and traceable; every understanding call conservative. Across our adversarial test set, zero honest students were ever falsely flagged.

points.title: You see every student
points.body: Not a sampled five — the whole class, with the ones who are quietly struggling surfaced before the test does it for you.

payoff.closing: Your evenings back. Grading that's fair and that you can defend. And — for the first time — every student, seen. That's the platform.
